Complete the implementation by resolving Jest/TypeScript configuration issues, enabling coverage collection, and creating the actual test implementations for each component: test-chunker.spec.ts, test-atoms.spec.ts, test-raptor.spec.ts, test-graph.spec.ts, test-orchestrator.spec.ts. Add property-based testing with fast-check for algorithmic components. Implement integration and performance test suites leveraging the existing test infrastructure.
tasks.testStrategy: Resolve Jest TypeScript configuration and module resolution issues first. Enable coverage collection after fixing syntax parsing problems with import type statements. Run existing test suites to verify integration with new testing infrastructure. Verify all tests pass with proper assertions leveraging custom matchers. Check code coverage reports meet minimum 80% threshold for each module using the configured HTML and LCOV outputs. Run integration tests using established DatabaseTestHelper and MockLLMHelper utilities. Performance test critical paths with existing PerformanceMeasurement and MemoryTracker utilities. Validate test isolation using cleanup procedures in global test setup.
